messages:
ellie: Quick thread about the suppression preview behaviour in compact SLO rows — we got feedback that hidden channels make it hard to audit. Proposing we keep suppressed channels visible but marked.
rahul: Agreed. Hiding feels like magic. What about a "suppressed" badge and 50% opacity?
natalie: Prefer a distinct label instead of just opacity. "(suppressed)" after the channel name is explicit and reads well with screen readers.
eng: Dev note: adding text is trivial but may expand rows. Compact layout has tight vertical space. We could show the badge only in expanded preview and use a muted icon in compact.
ellie: Idea: show a small slash icon (⛔/minus) next to name in compact, full "(suppressed)" text in preview panel. Also include hover tooltip explaining why (eg scheduled suppression or manual snooze).
natalie: Accessibility: the icon alone is ambiguous. Ensure icon has aria-label and the row annunciates state like "Slack #alerts, suppressed until 3:00 PM". Use aria-describedby to attach a human-readable reason.
rahul: For visual contrast, don't rely on opacity alone. We should pick a token color (surface-muted) that meets 4.5:1 against the background. Opacity on black text will often fail.
a11y-bot: Reminder: when using aria-describedby, test with NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver. Announcer must read channel name then state. Example: aria-describedby="#desc-123" with content "suppressed until 15:00".
ellie: Copy tweak for preview summary: current "Will notify: 3 channels" -> propose "Channels notified (suppressed shown)" with a small info icon linking to docs. Short and explicit.
eng: Also add keyboard flow: tab to row, press enter to open settings, shift+tab focus goes to toggle. Make sure suppressed rows are focusable even when toggled off.
natalie: Screen reader test case: ensure grammar reads naturally: "Slack channel: #alerts, notifications off, suppressed until 3 PM". Consider adding commas in the accessible label to aid articulation.
rahul: Implementation snippet for the accessible label we can set dynamically:
```
const label = `${provider} channel: ${name}, ${enabled ? 'notifications on' : 'notifications off'}${suppressed ? `, suppressed until ${timeLabel}` : ''}`;
channelElement.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
```
eng: Will add that and include unit tests. Also will avoid long labels for very long channel names by truncating in visual but keeping full label for screen readers.
ellie: UX decision: show suppressed channels in compact list but visually de-emphasized, explicit text in expanded preview. Agreed?
rahul: +1
natalie: +1, but please run a quick a11y pass with VoiceOver.
a11y-bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.com/alerting/suppression-audit-1777770001 — includes aria-labels and muted token tests. :rocket:
ellie: Thanks team — I'll capture the decision in the spec and update the follow-up tickets.
